title: Wall clock never wired in production: DIO root-sig replay gate + cross-check are dead code in every shipped config (provisioning sets wall_clock_unix: None everywhere)
description: Review finding (b7z9.88.3 security pass, P2): all four provisioning sites set wall_clock_unix: None (rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/provisioning.rs:62,104,145,197) and set_wall_clock_unix (mod.rs:163) is called only from tests. In production verify_dio_root_signature always exits at receive.rs:711 (clockless -> Baseline) for pinned keys, so the cross-check (receive.rs:721) and the entire replay gate (receive.rs:726-744 incl. RootSeqCache) are unreachable; the DioRootSigOutcome::Reject 'replayed signature' contract (receive.rs:646) is delivered in no production build. Forgery rejection (receive.rs:697-704) still works clockless. Producer side equally inert (transmit.rs:73). Fix is clock wiring (spec open question: NTP over CoAP vs GPS vs piggyback on DIO), not reordering — R-06-307 correctly treats unassessable clock as unsigned. Track until a trusted clock source is wired; when it is, the b7z9.88.3 gate pins become live paths.
